name: Ceramic armour plate
description: A curved ceramic plate in a black fabric cover, made to slide into a plate carrier.
notes: 250 by 300 mm, 12 mm thick, curved across its width, with shooter's cuts at the top corners and a white label on the cover. Fitting it into a carrier or vest has no content field yet. The size is a placeholder.

name: Steel chain
description: A heavy length of steel chain with round links.
notes: About 2.4 m of 8 mm stock with 40 mm round links, laid flat in four runs joined at the turns. The box counts the air between the runs and inside the links. tying is a new quality name for a rope quality. Swinging it as a weapon has no melee block in this draft.

name: Gold chalice
description: A gold cup on a knopped stem and a wide foot.
notes: 120 mm tall with an 80 mm cup. Its worth as a valuable has no content field yet.

name: Chamomile flowers
description: A handful of small white daisy-like flowers with yellow centres, picked for tea.
notes: Six heads 20 mm across on short stems, lying face up. cloth-white draws the petals, plastic-yellow the centres and plant-dried the stems. Brewing it into tea or using it as a remedy needs recipes.

name: Circular saw blade
description: An 8 inch steel saw blade with 24 hooked teeth.
notes: 204 mm across, a 2 mm plate with a 16 mm arbor hole inside a blued collar. Making a saw from it, or throwing it, needs recipes and a thrown-weapon block.

name: Lump of clay
description: A soft lump of fresh clay, ready to be shaped or fired.
notes: About 90 by 70 mm and 45 mm high. clay-terracotta draws it; a damp unfired clay finish would tell it apart from the fired pot. Shaping and firing need recipes.

name: Clay flower pot
description: A terracotta pot with a rolled rim, for growing plants.
notes: 155 mm tall and 176 mm across the rim. Planting in it has no content field yet.

name: Alarm clock
description: A red wind-up alarm clock with two bells on top, stopped at ten past ten.
notes: 110 mm across and 150 mm tall with bells, hammer, winding key and two feet. The box also counts the air round the bells and feet. Taking it apart for clockworks needs a disassembly block.

name: Clockworks
description: A few small brass gears, a steel pinion and a balance wheel.
notes: About 70 mm across: three brass gears meshing on their arbors, a pinion on the largest, and a loose balance wheel. Use in crafting needs recipes.

name: Sack of concrete mix
description: A small paper sack of dry cement, sand and gravel, mixed and ready to wet.
notes: Loose powder, drawn in the small paper sack a player would carry, 80 by 50 mm and 90 mm tall with its top rolled down, a printed band and a little spilled grey mix beside it. Mixing with water and pouring need recipes.

name: Condensing unit
description: A refrigeration compressor and fan on a steel base, with a finned copper condenser coil.
notes: 400 by 260 mm and about 300 mm tall: a domed compressor, a four-blade fan in its shroud and a finned coil with copper passes, joined by two copper lines. The box also counts the air round the parts. Building a fridge or freezer from it needs recipes. The size is a placeholder.

name: Cottonwood fluff
description: A loose white tuft of cottonwood seed fluff, too short and weak to spin.
notes: About 80 mm across: five overlapping white puffs with a small brown seed showing. Use as tinder or stuffing needs recipes.

name: Crude heating element
description: A coil of steel wire wound by hand, with a terminal loop at each end. It burns out quickly.
notes: 4 mm wire in 24 open turns on a 34 mm coil 200 mm long, with straight leads ending in loops, 300 mm overall. Fitting it to a heater or stove needs recipes, and its faster wear has no content field yet.

name: Delay fuze
description: A small clockwork fuze with a striker lever and a safety pin. It fires a few seconds after the pin is pulled.
notes: 38 mm long and 14 mm across: a threaded steel nose, an olive plastic body, a lever along the top and a pin with a pull ring. The box counts the ring standing off the side. Fitting it to an explosive needs recipes.

name: Diamond
description: A cut diamond a little under 4 carats.
notes: A round brilliant 10 mm across and 6.5 mm tall, standing on its point, in gem-clear. A one-carat stone would be only three voxels at the 2 mm grain, so the stone is drawn larger and the mass follows the drawn stone. The tiles draw it opaque, but it stays see-through in the game. Setting it in jewellery needs recipes.
